cs.t: A Fujifilm x100v camera. As a relatively new dad this thing is so fun to use and is really a step up from phone photos for capturing the fam. I had actually bought a Fuji x-t20 first only about a month ago, but serendipitously stumbled on a x100v in store and bought it as they’re extremely difficult to buy at the moment. I also initially wanted the x100v before I learned about the supply issues. I’m prob going to sell the x-t20 as the fixed lens on the x100v is more compact. In general definitely recommend looking into a mirror less camera if you want to boost your photos. I’ve only been using them for a month and not a pro by any means, but it’s been a lot of fun and I’ve already gotten complements on some of the photos I’ve taken.
